description: Generate a structured implementation plan using Kimi's --plan mode. Use BEFORE coding to get steps, files-to-touch, risks, and open questions. Distinct from ask-kimi: uses --plan flag (different system prompt) and parses structured output.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria the plan must satisfy.

constraints.description: Hard constraints (must-not-touch areas, style rules, deadlines).

contextFiles.description: Paths/globs to include as @-references in the prompt.

format.description: Output shape. json (default) returns structured steps/risks; markdown returns a checklist.

goal.description: What you want planned (a feature, refactor, investigation).

name: plan-kimi
